toggle_activation_word.name: Toggle activation word
toggle_activation_word.description: Toggle the activation word for Abacus (e.g. 'Abacus, search [x]')

ai_mode.name: AI mode
ai_mode.description: Enable free conversation mode with a local model

ai_commands.name: AI command recognition
ai_commands.description: Allows the AI mode to recognize commands in your words and execute them. This may be inaccurate. Turn on at your own risk

ai_model_path.name: AI model path
ai_model_path.description: Path to your local GGUF model file

ai_system_prompt.name: AI system prompt
ai_system_prompt.description: Personality and behavior instructions for Abacus in AI mode
ai_system_prompt.default: You are Abacus, a local desktop assistant. Be practical, calm, and concise.

ai_n_ctx.name: AI context size
ai_n_ctx.description: Max context tokens to keep in memory (2048 is a good start)

ai_max_tokens.name: AI reply length
ai_max_tokens.description: Max new tokens per reply (160-320 recommended)

ai_temperature.name: AI creativity
ai_temperature.description: Lower is focused, higher is creative (0.2-0.9)

ai_n_gpu_layers.name: AI GPU layers
ai_n_gpu_layers.description: Set 0 for CPU only, or higher if your GPU supports it

stt_provider.name: Speech recognition provider
stt_provider.description: Choose between online Google STT and local PocketSphinx

tts_provider.name: Text to speech provider
tts_provider.description: Choose between online Edge TTS and local pyttsx3

name.name: Name
name.description: Change what you would like to be called
